editedText.5:57: Make it easy to browse and use Tebra’s assets yourself.
editedText.5:62:
In your new file, open Assets → Libraries. Find Design System Rebuild and confirm the source using the link below.

Choose Add to file. If it appears under Used in this file, it is already added. Close the dialog to browse its assets.
editedText.5:63: Codex can import accessible published components through the Figma connection without this manual step. Adding the library is recommended for browsing and editing in Figma.
editedText.5:59: Example from SDE Alpha Prototypes: Design System Rebuild appears under Used in this file. Follow these steps in your own new file.
editedText.5:66: If added, Design System Rebuild appears under Used in this file. Codex still checks published-library access and reports any import problems.
